ParameterCovariance.description: The covariance of a result's estimated parameters.

covariance.description: Covariance of the shared parameters: one row per label, symmetric.

fixed.description:
Labels of the parameters held fixed. The covariance is conditional on
them.

labels.description: Labels of the shared parameters, in the order of `covariance`.

noise.description:
The noise level of each kind of residual, estimated from the
residuals at the solution.

num_residuals.description: Number of scalar residuals, priors included.

view_scatter.description:
How many times the variance of the shared parameters across views
exceeds what the residual noise predicts, from the scatter of the
views' contributions to the fit. The residual noise model takes every
corner's error as independent; errors shared by a view's corners (a
lens model or target that does not fit exactly, a detector bias) are
not in it, and on real images make the estimate vary between view
sets several times more than predicted. When above 1, `covariance`
and `views` are already scaled by it. `None` below six views.

views.description: Per-view parameters, one block per view that has free ones.

ProjectionUncertainty.description:
The projection uncertainty of one camera over its image.

Grid nodes are evenly spaced from pixel `(0, 0)` to
`(width − 1, height − 1)`, corners included, and listed row by row from
the top-left. Each value is the major-axis standard deviation, in pixels,
of where the ray through the node projects.

center.description: σ at the image centre, pixels.

corner.description:
The largest σ of the four corners, pixels; `None` when no ray reaches
any of them.

max.description: The largest σ of the grid and the centre, pixels.

sigma.description:
Major-axis σ at each node, pixels. `None` where no ray reaches the
node, as where a strong distortion folds the image over.

ResidualKind.description: A kind of residual, which sets its unit.

oneOf.description: Laser line distance in the image, pixels.

ResidualNoise.description: The estimated noise level of one kind of residual.

oneOf.description:
`σ̂` in the residual kind's unit: pixels for reprojection and the
laser line, metres for the laser plane.

`σ̂₀` of residuals whitened by their stated per-point covariances:
dimensionless, the square root of the a-posteriori variance factor.
About 1 when the stated covariances describe the noise; 2 means the
actual noise is twice what they state.

count.description: Number of scalar residuals of this kind.

ViewCovariance.description: The covariance of one view's own parameters.

covariance.description: Their covariance: one row per label, symmetric.

labels.description: Labels of the view's parameters, e.g. `camera_se3_target.rx`.

view.description: View index, as in the result's per-view lists.

description:
The covariance a calibration is predicted to have with candidate views
added.

covariance.description:
The predicted covariance of the parameters the result estimated, with
the result's labels, fixed list and noise levels. Per-view blocks are
not predicted (`views` is empty); `num_residuals` and `dof` count the
candidates' visible points and poses.

effective_noise_px.description:
The standard deviation of a pixel residual (per axis) the result's
covariance implies, which scales the candidates' information, in
pixels.

projection.description: The predicted projection uncertainty over the image.

visible_points.description:
Per candidate, in order, the target points that land in the image.
A candidate with fewer than four adds no information.

title: PredictedUncertainty
